description: This file defines a 'Trash' class managing trash items (notes and notebooks) in the Notesnook project, including cache building, cleanup, add, delete, restore, and grouping functionalities.

classes.name: Trash
classes.description: A class managing trash items (notes and notebooks), including cache management, cleanup, add, delete, restore, and grouping functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Trash instance by building the cache.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of trashed notes and notebooks from the database.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes expired trash items based on deletion date and cleanup interval.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds notes or notebooks to the trash.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Internal method to delete notes and notebooks from cache and database.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores trash items back to active notes or notebooks.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all trash items from cache and database.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all trash items, optionally filtered by 'deletedBy' status.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns total number of trash items.

methods.name: trashedNotes
methods.description: Fetches trashed notes from the database.

methods.name: trashedNotebooks
methods.description: Fetches trashed notebooks from the database.

methods.name: grouped
methods.description: Returns grouped trash items based on provided options.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in trash cache.

methods.name: subNotebooks
methods.description: Fetches sub-notebooks related to given notebooks.
